set system host-name NATA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit 0 family inet address 192.168.10.1/.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set security zones security-zone trust.explanation: This command fragment configures a security zone named `[parameter1]` within the Junos security zones hierarchy, defining a logical boundary for security policies and interfaces.

interfaces ge-0/0/0 host-inbound-traffic.explanation: The interfaces with the secure Zone of Confidence allow all system service entry traffic.

parameters.name: system-services
parameters.explanation: Allowed type of system service, e.g. all.

set security zones security-zone untrust.explanation: This command fragment configures a security zone named `[parameter1]` within the Junos security zones hierarchy, defining a logical boundary for security policies and interfaces.

interfaces ge-0/0/1 host-inbound-traffic.explanation: The interface with the untrusted area of the security area allows all system service entry traffic.

parameters.name: system-services
parameters.explanation: Allowed type of system service, e.g. all.

set security nat source pool address-gro.command: set security nat source pool address-group1
set security nat source pool address-gro.explanation: This command configures a source NAT pool named `[parameter1]` in Junos, defining a range of IP addresses used for translating private source IPs to public IPs.

address 11.11.11.101 to 11.11.11.105.explanation: Configure the address range of the source NAT address pool.

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule set in Junos, defining a collection of rules for translating source IP addresses in traffic matching specified criteria.

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the NAT rule book.

from zone trust.explanation: Configure the application area for the source NAT ruleset.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.explanation: Source area name, such as trust.

to zone untrust.explanation: Configure the application target area for the source NAT ruleset.

rule NAT-INSIDE match source-address 192.explanation: Configure the source address range that the source NAT rules match.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet mask bits in the source address range.

rule NAT-INSIDE then source-nat pool add.command: rule NAT-INSIDE then source-nat pool address-group1
rule NAT-INSIDE then source-nat pool add.explanation: Configure the source address conversion behaviour for source NAT rules.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.explanation: Name of the address pool used to convert the source address, e.g., address-group1.
